summary: Completed e2e testing of Iteration 28 features: External Providers Webhooks (real micro-task provider integration) and NPC Skill-based Services System. All 22 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend NPCServices.jsx page verified with all categories, NPC lookup, and service display working correctly. NPC Services button on ModeSelection page confirmed working.
critical_code_review_comments: external_providers_router included at line 7215-7216 with prefix /api
npc_services_router included at line 7223-7224 with prefix /api
POST /api/external-providers/webhook/{provider} - Receives webhooks from Toloka, MTurk, Scale AI, Hive, Appen with signature verification
Webhook events normalized: ASSIGNMENT_ACCEPTED→task_approved, ASSIGNMENT_REJECTED→task_rejected, POOL_OPENED→task_available
GET /api/external-providers/status returns webhook_secrets_configured, supported_event_types, recent_events, provider_availability, task_mapping_stats
POST /api/external-providers/tasks/map creates internal tracking for external tasks with external_task_id, provider, task_type, payout
POST /api/external-providers/tasks/claim allows workers to claim available tasks
POST /api/external-providers/tasks/submit submits task responses with pending_review status
GET /api/npc-services/categories returns 6 categories: combat(3), crafting(5), magic(4), social(3), knowledge(3), survival(3) = 21 total services
GET /api/npc-services/types returns all service definitions with mastery_requirements (novice→grandmaster) and quality_multipliers (0.5→1.5)
GET /api/npc-services/npc/{npc_id}/available returns services NPC can provide based on trained skills from AI Training system
POST /api/npc-services/request validates: service exists, NPC has skill at required mastery, player has balance, cooldown not active
Service quality calculated from NPC mastery level with variance, cost scales with mastery (premium for higher skill)
NPCServices.jsx has proper data-testid attributes: back-button, refresh-button, tab-browse, tab-history, npc-id-input, check-npc-button
ModeSelection.jsx has NPC Services button at line 511-522 with data-testid='npc-services-btn'
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing sirix_1 account and test_npc_1 NPC (trained in blacksmithing to Expert level).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 28 External Providers and NPC Services fully tested. Key endpoints: POST /api/external-providers/webhook/{provider} (toloka/mturk/scale_ai/hive/appen), GET /api/external-providers/status, GET /api/external-providers/events, POST /api/external-providers/tasks/map, POST /api/external-providers/tasks/claim, POST /api/external-providers/tasks/submit, GET /api/npc-services/categories (6 categories, 21 services), GET /api/npc-services/types (full service definitions), GET /api/npc-services/npc/{npc_id}/available (services based on trained skills), POST /api/npc-services/request (request service with VE$ payment), GET /api/npc-services/history/{player_id}, GET /api/npc-services/npc/{npc_id}/stats, GET /api/npc-services/leaderboard. Frontend: NPCServices.jsx at /npc-services with Browse/History tabs, category display, NPC lookup, service request. ModeSelection has NPC Services button with data-testid='npc-services-btn'. test_npc_1 is trained in blacksmithing (Expert) and offers: Forge Weapon (VE$17.18), Forge Armor (VE$28.62), Repair Equipment (VE$5.72).
